Check whether the proposed roadmap is community-aligned.

## Tasks
- Review `.stage/ROADMAP-XXX/issue-summary.md`.
- Evaluate and document:
  - Evidence of community discussion
  - Interested contributors/committers
  - Scope fit with project goals
  - Signs of vendor-imposed direction (if any)
- Save findings to `.stage/ROADMAP-XXX/community-alignment.md`.
- Ask for user confirmation before moving on.

## Rules
- Record evidence links or references for every conclusion.
- If alignment is weak, propose a smaller initial scope.
